intel.listening_usage: Catch-all plan boundary for attributed Intel provider usage that predates a finer operation key.
intel.workspace_credits_view: Legacy read-only workspace credit and active-plan visibility retained during the plan-only transition.
intel.ai_invoke: One directly requested Intel AI invocation through the plan-aware AI endpoint.
intel.assistant_chat: One streamed Intel assistant turn, including its grounded data-tool calls.
intel.assistant_action: Allows confirmed assistant mutations such as creating campaigns, listeners, briefs, and preferences.
intel.suggest_listeners_setup: AI-assisted listener, keyword, source, and competitor setup suggestions.
intel.listener_suggestions: On-demand suggestions for improving an existing listener configuration.
intel.competitor_suggestions: AI-assisted discovery of competitors for a monitored brand.
intel.custom_tool_build: Builds a workspace-specific read-only assistant tool through the guided tool builder.
intel.custom_tool_run: Executes a saved workspace-specific assistant tool.
intel.listener_subscribe: Adds one brand listener to a workspace monitoring portfolio.
intel.listener_subscriptions_read: Access to the workspace listener portfolio and effective per-workspace overlays.
intel.listener_unsubscribe: Allows a workspace to stop monitoring a subscribed listener.
intel.listener_overlay_update: Edits keywords, exclusions, relevance thresholds, alert sensitivity, digest cadence, and competitor overlays.
intel.listener_status_update: Pauses, resumes, archives, or otherwise updates a listener's operational status.
intel.entities_read: Reads workspace-scoped Intel entities through the compatibility entity API.
intel.entity_update: Updates one supported workspace-scoped Intel entity.
intel.entity_delete: Deletes one supported workspace-scoped Intel entity.
intel.backfill_start: Starts a serialized historical coverage backfill for a listener and its competitor shadows.
intel.backfill_status: Reads coverage and backfill progress for subscribed listeners.
intel.source_gdelt_news: Continuous and historical global-news discovery through GDELT.
intel.firecrawl:news: Provider-backed news search used as a resilient ingestion and backfill source.
intel.source_rss_news: Forward-only ingestion from configured RSS and Google News feeds.
intel.source_youtube: YouTube video and channel mention monitoring with historical coverage support.
intel.apify:twitter: Cadence-controlled X/Twitter search and engagement refresh through Apify.
intel.apify:instagram: Cadence-controlled Instagram post monitoring through Apify.
intel.apify:tiktok: Cadence-controlled TikTok monitoring and engagement refresh through Apify.
intel.app_review_ingest: Fetches and stores Play Store and App Store customer-review intelligence.
intel.enrich: AI enrichment for relevance, sentiment, intent, topics, entities, language, and embedding preparation.
intel.relevance_analysis: Layered prefiltering, semantic relevance scoring, exclusions, and operator correction controls for ingested mentions.
intel.sentiment_analysis: Directional sentiment, magnitude, rationale, and threshold-based reputation analysis.
intel.intent_analysis: Classifies the intent and actionability of enriched mentions.
intel.topic_entity_analysis: Extracts topics, named entities, tags, and subject buckets from monitored content.
intel.semantic_search: Embedding-backed search that retrieves mentions by meaning rather than exact wording.
intel.mention_translate: On-demand translation of a stored mention.
intel.mention_refresh: Refreshes engagement counters for a stored social mention.
intel.data_audit: Aggregated ingestion, enrichment, rejection, and quality diagnostics.
intel.data_audit_detail: Drill-down diagnostics for rejected, duplicate, incomplete, and provider-specific mention quality.
intel.rejected_mentions: Review, restore, and correct mentions held back by relevance and exclusion rules.
intel.mention_feedback: Captures operator corrections and feedback against individual mention analyses.
intel.correction_stats: Reports correction patterns and model-quality feedback statistics.
intel.data_coverage: Explains source-specific coverage, historical limitations, and outstanding backfill gaps.
intel.stories: Clusters enriched mentions into emerging narratives and evolving stories.
intel.story_feed: Access to workspace story lists and story state filters.
intel.campaign_management: Creates and manages crisis, communications, and tracking campaigns.
intel.campaign_attribution: Links relevant mentions to campaigns during the Pulse pipeline and on demand.
intel.campaign_analytics: Campaign reach, sentiment, source, timeline, and performance analytics.
intel.campaign_report: Generates a campaign intelligence report for preview, download, or delivery.
intel.alerts: Access to real-time alert detection, review, acknowledgment, and resolution workflows.
intel.alert_status_update: Acknowledges, resolves, and updates the lifecycle of an Intel alert.
intel.alert_volume_spike: Detects mention-volume spikes against a rolling brand baseline.
intel.alert_sentiment_drop: Detects material deterioration in negative share and reputation thresholds.
intel.alert_vip_mention: Alerts on configured VIP handles and high-reach authors.
intel.alert_keyword: Triggers alerts when monitored keywords appear in qualifying mentions.
intel.alert_story_threshold: Triggers alerts when a story crosses configured volume or significance thresholds.
intel.scct: Situational Crisis Communication Theory classification, responsibility analysis, and response playbook generation.
intel.crisis_score: On-demand AI crisis severity, trajectory, and recommended-response scoring.
intel.escalation_routing: Routes anomalies and alerts to the relevant workspace departments and escalation rules.
intel.war_rooms: Creates and manages collaborative crisis war-room records around active incidents.
intel.push_subscribe: Browser push subscriptions, preferences, test delivery, and alert fan-out.
intel.digest: Builds and sends scheduled workspace intelligence digests.
intel.send_daily_digest: Sends an on-demand daily digest to the requesting workspace user.
intel.synthesize: Scheduled grounded narrative synthesis with source citations and recommended actions.
intel.generate_brief: Generates a source-grounded intelligence brief on demand.
intel.generate_report: Generates full, sentiment, volume, engagement, or competitive intelligence reports in preview, PDF, CSV, or email form.
intel.report_templates: Creates, edits, and applies reusable workspace report templates.
intel.report_export: Exports campaign and listener intelligence in PDF or CSV form.
intel.dashboard_stats: Workspace dashboard totals, trends, source mix, sentiment, reach, engagement, and reputation signals.
intel.period_stats: Canonical period-window analytics across listeners and campaigns.
intel.mention_breakdown: Breaks mentions down by source, sentiment, topics, geography, author, reach, and engagement.
intel.share_of_voice: Compares canonical brand and competitor mention volume over a shared coverage window.
intel.listener_buckets_save: Saves brand-specific subject buckets used to classify and compare mentions.
intel.listener_buckets_suggest: Suggests brand-specific analysis buckets from recent mention topics.
intel.team_departments: Creates departments, assigns members, and maps alert topics to responsible teams.
intel.dashboard_sharing: Creates and manages workspace dashboard-share records.
intel.public_api_request: One authenticated external API request for listeners, mentions, metrics, campaigns, stories, alerts, briefs, or live search.
intel.api_key_management: Mints, lists, and revokes Intel external API credentials.
intel.max_brand_listeners: Maximum number of brand listeners a workspace plan may monitor.
intel.max_competitors_per_listener: Maximum competitors selectable for each brand listener. The current runtime hard ceiling is five.
intel.max_backfill_days: Maximum historical lookback available to a plan. The current runtime ceiling is 365 days.
intel.backfill_window_days: Duration of each serialized history-fetch window.
intel.ingest_interval_minutes: Base Pulse pipeline interval for news ingestion, backfill, enrichment, stories, campaigns, alerts, refresh, and digests.
intel.social_cadence: Sensitivity-tier mapping that controls paid and free social-source fetch frequency.
intel.competitor_social_cadence: Social sampling frequency for competitor-shadow listeners when competitor social monitoring is enabled.
intel.social_live_item_cap: Maximum live social items requested per platform run after cadence scaling.
intel.alert_interval_minutes: How often the Pulse pipeline evaluates alert conditions.
intel.alert_cooldown_hours: Re-fire suppression duration for each listener and alert trigger.
intel.alert_thresholds: Volume-spike and negative-share thresholds for each listener sensitivity tier.
intel.brief_schedule: Scheduled brief frequency, UTC generation hour, and analysis-window duration.
intel.digest_frequency: Digest cadence choices available to listener subscribers.
intel.engagement_refresh_policy: Controls how long and how frequently recent social engagement metrics are refreshed.
intel.enrichment_batch_size: Maximum brand and competitor mentions enriched during each Pulse run.
intel.assistant_rate_policy: Assistant chat window and concurrency policy.
intel.tool_rate_policy: Custom tool run and builder window/concurrency policy.
intel.public_api_rate_policy: Plan-visible external API access and page-size policy.
